arxiv-1705-10557.title: Universal Reinforcement Learning Algorithms: Survey and Experiments
arxiv-1705-10557.creator: John Aslanides, Jan Leike, Marcus Hutter
arxiv-1705-10557.description: Abstract Many state-of-the-art reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms typically assume that the environment is an ergodic Markov Decision Process (MDP). In contrast, the field of universal reinforcement learning (URL) is concerned with algorithms that make as few assumptions as possible about the environment. The universal Bayesian agent AIXI and a family of related URL algorithms have been developed in this setting.

arxiv-1812-03024.title: Dickson’s Lemma, Higman’s Theorem and Beyond: a survey of some basic results in order theory Thanks: Supported by the Austrian Science Fund (FWF): P29931.
arxiv-1812-03024.creator: Erhard Aichinger, Florian Aichinger
arxiv-1812-03024.description: Abstract . We provide proofs for the fact that certain orders have no descending chains and no antichains. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 06A06(03E04) 1. Introduction We investigate some finiteness conditions of a partially ordered set ({A},{\leq}) . As usual, we write a\geq b for b\leq a , and a<b (or b>a ) for a\leq b and a\neq b .

arxiv-2010-09780.title: Technical Question Answering across Tasks and Domains
arxiv-2010-09780.creator: Wenhao Yu, Lingfei Wu, Yu Deng, Qingkai Zeng,, Ruchi Mahindru, Sinem Guven, Meng Jiang † {\dagger} University of Notre Dame, Notre Dame, IN, USA ‡ {\ddagger} IBM Thomas J. Watson Research Center, Yorktown Heights, NY, USA † {\dagger} {wyu1, qzeng, mjiang2}@nd.edu ‡ {\ddagger} {wuli, dengy, rmahindr,
arxiv-2010-09780.description: Abstract Building automatic technical support system is an important yet challenge task. Conceptually, to answer a user question on a technical forum, a human expert has to first retrieve relevant documents, and then read them carefully to identify the answer snippet.

arxiv-2106-03166.title: Hardy-Rellich and second order Poincaré identities on the hyperbolic space via Bessel pairs
arxiv-2106-03166.creator: Elvise BERCHIO, Debdip Ganguly, Prasun Roychowdhury
arxiv-2106-03166.description: Abstract . We prove a family of Hardy-Rellich and Poincaré identities and inequalities on the hyperbolic space having, as particular cases, improved Hardy-Rellich, Rellich and second order Poincaré inequalities. All remainder terms provided considerably improve those already known in literature, and all identities hold with same constants for radial operators also.

arxiv-2107-13171.title: Learning with Multiclass AUC: Theory and Algorithms
arxiv-2107-13171.creator: Zhiyong Yang, Qianqian Xu*, Senior Member, IEEE, Shilong Bao, Senior Member, IEEE, and Qingming Huang*, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2107-13171.description: Abstract The Area under the ROC curve (AUC) is a well-known ranking metric for problems such as imbalanced learning and recommender systems. The vast majority of existing AUC-optimization-based machine learning methods only focus on binary-class cases, while leaving the multiclass cases unconsidered.

arxiv-2111-08196.title: An Exploratory Study on Perceptual Spaces of the Singing Voice
arxiv-2111-08196.creator: Brendan O’Connor, Simon Dixon, George Fazekas
arxiv-2111-08196.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Brendan O’Connor, Simon Dixon, George Fazekas. Sixty participants provided dissimilarity ratings between various singing techniques. Multidimensional scaling, class averaging and clustering techniques were used to analyse timbral spaces and how they change between different singers, genders and registers. Clustering analysis showed that ground-truth similarity and silhouette scores that were not significantly different between gender or register conditions, while similarity scores were positively correlated with participants’ instrumental abilities and task comprehension.

arxiv-2209-13440.title: Norms of embeddings between quadratically weighted spaces of holomorphic functions
arxiv-2209-13440.creator: Joe Viola
arxiv-2209-13440.description: Abstract . We consider spaces of holomorphic functions which are square-integrable against a Gaussian weight, which appear in the theory of metaplectic FBI–Bargmann transforms. We identify the operator norm of embeddings between two such spaces, by relating these embeddings to Fourier integral operators with complex phase. 1.

arxiv-2301-12990.title: First results on FHM – a Floating Hole Multiplier
arxiv-2301-12990.creator: and A. Breskin
arxiv-2301-12990.description: Abstract A proof of principle of a novel concept for event recording in dual-phase liquid xenon detectors — the Floating Hole Multiplier (FHM) — is presented. It is shown that a standard Thick Gaseous Electron Multiplier (THGEM), freely floating on the liquid xenon surface permits extraction of electrons from the liquid to the gas.

arxiv-2311-06822.title: Cluster properties of heavy nuclei predicted with the Barcelona-Catania-Paris-Madrid energy density functional
arxiv-2311-06822.creator: Samuel A. Giuliani, Luis M. Robledo
arxiv-2311-06822.description: Abstract We study the cluster emission properties of 224 Ra and 238 Pu employing the Barcelona-Catania-Paris-Madrid (BCPM) energy density functional (EDF). Starting from two-dimensional potential energy surfaces, coexisting fission paths are identified. A fission valley located at large octupole deformations, corresponding to a highly-asymmetric mass distribution, is found in both nuclei.

arxiv-2312-04405.title: A universal scheme to self-test any quantum state and extremal measurement
arxiv-2312-04405.creator: Shubhayan Sarkar, Alexandre C. Orthey, Jr, Remigiusz Augusiak
arxiv-2312-04405.description: Abstract The emergence of quantum devices has raised a significant issue: how to certify the quantum properties of a device without placing trust in it. To characterise quantum states and measurements in a device-independent way, up to some degree of freedom, we can make use of a technique known as self-testing.

arxiv-2405-01540.title: Universal Imitation Games Thanks: This paper is a condensed draft of a forthcoming book.
arxiv-2405-01540.creator: Sridhar Mahadevan
arxiv-2405-01540.description: Abstract In 1950 1950 , Alan Turing proposed a framework called an imitation game in which the participants are to be classified Human or Machine solely from natural language interactions. Using mathematics largely developed since Turing – category theory – we investigate a broader class of universal imitation games (UIGs).

arxiv-2406-05118.title: The SRG/eROSITA All-Sky Survey: X-ray beacons at late cosmic dawn
arxiv-2406-05118.creator: J. Wolf, M. Salvato, S. Belladitta, R. Arcodia S. Ciroi, F. Di Mille, T. Sbarrato, J. Buchner S. Hämmerich, J. Wilms, W. Collmar, T. Dwelly, A. Merloni, T. Urrutia, K. Nandra
arxiv-2406-05118.description: Abstract Context. The Spectrum Roentgen Gamma (SRG)/eROSITA All-Sky Survey (eRASS) is expected to contain ∼ 100 \sim 100 quasars that emitted their light when the universe was less than a billion years old, i.e. at z > 5.6 z>5.6 .

arxiv-2407-19558.title: Identification and Inference with Invalid Instruments
arxiv-2407-19558.creator: Hyunseung Kang, 1 Zijian Guo, 2 Zhonghua Liu, 3 and Dylan Small 4
arxiv-2407-19558.description: Abstract Instrumental variables (IVs) are widely used to study the causal effect of an exposure on an outcome in the presence of unmeasured confounding. IVs require an instrument, a variable that is (A1) associated with the exposure, (A2) has no direct effect on the outcome except through the exposure, and (A3) is not related to unmeasured confounders.

arxiv-2411-01921.title: J-contractive operator valued functions, vector valued de Branges spaces and functional models
arxiv-2411-01921.creator: Bharti Garg, Santanu Sarkar
arxiv-2411-01921.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Bharti Garg, Santanu Sarkar. In this paper, we study the reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHS) which are constructed from J J -contractive operator valued analytic functions on the upper half plane. First, we discuss the Potapov-Ginzburg transform of a specific class of Fredholm operators, investigate some of its properties, and outline sufficient conditions for a J J -contractive operator to be J J -bicontractive. Subsequently, we construct certain classes of vector valued de Branges spaces and aim to explore the significance of these classes.

arxiv-2505-20629.title: Unified Text-Image-to-Video Generation: A Training-Free Approach to Flexible Visual Conditioning
arxiv-2505-20629.creator: Bolin Lai Sangmin Lee Xu Cao Xiang Li James M. Rehg, 1 Georgia Tech 2 UIUC 3 Korea University, bolin.lai@gatech.edu sangmin-lee@korea.ac.kr {xucao2,xiangl12,jrehg}@illinois.edu, Project Page: https://bolinlai.github.io/projects/FlexTI2V/
arxiv-2505-20629.description: Abstract Text-image-to-video (TI2V) generation is a critical problem for controllable video generation using both semantic and visual conditions. Most existing methods typically add visual conditions to text-to-video (T2V) foundation models by finetuning, which is costly in resources and only limited to a few pre-defined conditioning settings.

arxiv-2509-26061.title: Multi-modal Liver Segmentation and Fibrosis Staging Using Real-world MRI Images
arxiv-2509-26061.creator: Yang Zhou, Kunhao Yuan, Ye Wei, Jishizhan Chen
arxiv-2509-26061.description: Abstract Liver fibrosis represents the accumulation of excessive extracellular matrix caused by sustained hepatic injury. It disrupts normal lobular architecture and function, increasing the chances of cirrhosis and liver failure. Precise staging of fibrosis for early diagnosis and intervention is often invasive, which carries risks and complications.

pmc-10665505.title: Predictors of Suboptimal Adherence Among Children on Antiretroviral Therapy in Southern Ethiopia: A Multicenter Retrospective Follow-Up Study
pmc-10665505.creator: Tamirat Gezahegn Guyo, Fasika Merid, Temesgen Mohammed Toma
pmc-10665505.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Objectives: Despite increased access to and availability of antiretroviral therapy, the program’s effectiveness is primarily affected by treatment adherence. Therefore, this study aimed to determine the magnitude and predictors of suboptimal adherence among children on ART in Southern Ethiopia. Methods: A multicenter retrospective study was conducted among human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infected children in Gamo and South Omo zone public health facilities. To identify factors associated with suboptimal adherence, a binary logistic regression model was fitted.

pmc-10738166.title: ASSOCIATIONS BETWEEN COGNITIVE RESOURCES AND EMOTION REGULATION TACTICS IN AN ADULT LIFESPAN SAMPLE
pmc-10738166.creator: Hannah Wolfe, Marissa DiGirolamo, Derek Isaacowitz
pmc-10738166.description: The current study investigated how trait-level cognitive capacity relates to emotion regulation tactic preferences in everyday life in adulthood and old age. 51 younger adults (ages 18-39), 53 middle-aged adults (ages 40-59), and 55 older adults (ages 60+) completed measures of working memory and verbal fluency, as well as 21 days of experience sampling.

pmc-11385620.title: “I don’t wanna die, but my brain insists that I should”: a big qualitative data approach to the lived experiences of suicidal thoughts
pmc-11385620.creator: Lauro Estivalete Marchionatti, Rafael Ramos Amaral, Camila Barcellos, Samanta Duarte, André Cardoso Campello, Eduardo Virtuoso, Pedro Vieira da Silva Magalhães
pmc-11385620.description: IntroductionThere remains a dearth of knowledge concerning the phenomenology of suicidal thoughts, with research focusing on reasons for feeling suicidal rather than their mental expression. While clinical interviews remain the standard phenomenological approach, such exploration of lived experiences may prove challenging for this sensitive topic.

pmc-11536435.title: Deep Proteome Analysis of Cerebrospinal Fluid from Pediatric Patients with Central Nervous System Cancer
pmc-11536435.creator: Christian Mirian, Ole Østergaard, Maria Thastrup, Signe Modvig, Jon Foss-Skiftesvik, Jane Skjøth-Rasmussen, Marianne Berntsen, Josefine Britze, Alex Christian Yde Nielsen, René Mathiasen, Kjeld Schmiegelow, Jesper Velgaard Olsen
pmc-11536435.description: The cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is a key matrix for discovery of biomarkers relevant for prognosis and the development of therapeutic targets in pediatric central nervous system malignancies. However, the wide range of protein concentrations and age-related differences in children makes such discoveries challenging. In addition, pediatric CSF samples are often sparse and first prioritized for clinical purposes.

pmc-11608909.title: Spinal Anesthesia for Open Appendectomy in a Patient With Cystic Fibrosis and Coagulation Abnormalities: A Case of Tailored Anesthetic Management
pmc-11608909.creator: Leonor Lemos, Henrique Guimarães, Eduardo Tavares, Tiago Miguel Cardoso, António Costa, Cristina Poiarez
pmc-11608909.description: Cystic fibrosis (CF) is a genetic disorder that primarily affects the respiratory and gastrointestinal systems, often leading to significant perioperative challenges due to compromised lung function, recurrent infections, and chronic respiratory failure. Managing anesthesia in patients with CF requires careful consideration, particularly because of the increased risk of respiratory complications with general anesthesia (GA).

pmc-12745928.title: Utilization and Satisfaction of an On-Demand Telemedicine Service in Urban and Rural Communities
pmc-12745928.creator: Sara HELVEY, Jami MANN, Amir BARZIN, Barbara EDSON, Saif KHAIRAT
pmc-12745928.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Health disparities between urban and rural America have been studied extensively, and findings consistently show many inequities. The objective of this study was to evaluate patient experiences and utilization among patients in North Carolina who use telemedicine. A retrospective cohort study was performed to examine the utilization and satisfaction of patients using a virtual care service at a Southeastern Medical Center in the U.S. Of 1974 telemedicine patients, 1366 (79.3%) were female, 1046(60.7%) were between 35–64 years, 913(53%) had insurance coverage.

pmc-13242141.title: Integrating single-cell multi-omics and machine learning to reveal triaptosis heterogeneity in clear cell renal cell carcinoma
pmc-13242141.creator: Haojie Dai, Renjun Lu, Mingcong Zhang, Zhenyu Hang, Ke Jiang, Chao Qin, You Zhao
pmc-13242141.description: Triaptosis, an emerging form of cell death, remains poorly characterized in terms of its heterogeneity within clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC). Utilizing single-cell transcriptomics, we delineate a landscape of triaptosis heterogeneity and identify monocytes and macrophages as exhibiting the highest triaptosis activity, which further increases upon terminal differentiation. These high-activity cells also demonstrate enhanced pro-angiogenic signaling toward endothelial cells.

pmc-13336130.title: Deep Eutectic Polymer Electrolyte with Competitive Hydrogen‐Bonding Coordination for High‐Voltage Nickel‐rich Lithium Metal Batteries
pmc-13336130.creator: Yuxin Fan, Miao He, Yin Hu, Wei Chen, Yichao Yan, Tianyu Lei, Dongjiang Chen
pmc-13336130.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The pursuit of high‐energy‐density solid‐state batteries using Li metal anodes and high‐voltage Ni‐rich cathodes is hindered by severe interfacial degradation. Conventional polymer electrolytes with electronegative groups strongly adsorb high‐valent nickel, accelerating cathode decomposition and oxygen release. Here, we develop a deep‐eutectic polymer electrolyte (p‐DEPE) via in situ copolymerization of cyanoacrylate and butyl acrylate within a LiTFSI/LiDFOB dual‐salt network to reshape the interfacial chemistry.

pmc-13377612.title: Osteochondritis Dissecans of the Medial Femoral Condyle With Intra‐Articular Meniscal Calcification: A Rare Case and Literature Review
pmc-13377612.creator: Ekrem Özdemir, Nasuhi Altay
pmc-13377612.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Osteochondritis dissecans (OCD) is a joint disorder characterized by subchondral bone necrosis and potential fragment detachment; although intra‐articular loose bodies are common, a meniscal‐fixed calcified body associated with OCD is exceedingly rare. This case reports a 56‐year‐old male with a Stage 4B OCD lesion on the medial femoral condyle and a concomitant calcified body fixed to the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, which was identified via MRI as a primary driver of chronic mechanical stress and lesion progression.
